Join eFax® in Chicago for RSNA 2026, the premier gathering for radiology professionals and medical imaging leaders. As healthcare providers gather to advance imaging technology and patient care, eFax® will be onsite showcasing our enhanced inbound document processing and workflow platform.


Visit us to learn more about eFax® Harmony. Operating right alongside your existing RIS, eFax® Harmony instantly digitizes static documents, automates the prior-authorization workflow, and ensures you capture every referral—eliminating trapped orders, streamlining intake, and helping your organization stay compliant with new CMS regulations.
